name: merge-not-eligible
config:
[board]
people = ["sam", "alex"]

[hosts.helper]
ssh = "factory@helper.example"

[projects.gem]
path = "/nonexistent/gem"
base = "main"
github = "example/gem"

[projects.widgets]
path = "/nonexistent/widgets"
base = "main"

[projects.notes]
mode = "board"

[[schedules]]
name = "bug-hunt"
every_days = 30
kind = "task"
title = "Bug hunt"
body = "Look in {github} for bugs."

[[recipes]]
name = "docs-pass"
title = "Tidy the docs"
body = "Read the README."
projects = ["widgets"]

[[recipes]]
name = "scan"
kind = "prospect"
title = "Scan"
body = "Look around {github}."
